newsitem.title: USA: Jefferson Smurfit to buy Seagram's plant.
newsitem.headline: Jefferson Smurfit to buy Seagram's plant.

text.p: Jefferson Smurfit Corp said Friday it reached an agreement to buy a corrugated box plant from Tropicana Dole Beverages North America (TDBNA), a unit of Seagram Co Ltd.

Under the agreement, which becomes effective January 31, Jefferson Smurfit will purchase the box manufacturing equipment and lease the 173,000 square foot plant in Tropicana Dole Beverage North America's complex in Bradenton, Florida.
The company said it would supply Tropicana with corrugated boxes from the facility under a long-term purchase arrangement.
The sale price and other terms were not disclosed.
When the transaction is finalized, the Tropicana workers will become employees of Jefferson Smurfit.
Jefferson Smurfit Corp is a large manufacturer of corrugated containers, with 53 plants nationwide. It is 47 percent-owned by Jefferson Smurfit Group PLC, based in Ireland.
Tropicana Dole, a producer and marketer of orange juice, said it sold the Bradenton plant to focus on its core business.
